warmup: pnpm exec supabase start && pnpm exec supabase stop

supabase.cmd: pnpm exec supabase start && exec docker logs -f --since 1s supabase_db_app

web.cmd: until out=$(pnpm exec supabase status -o env 2>/dev/null) && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '^API_URL="http'; do sleep 2; done; eval "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E '^[A-Z_]+=')"; SUPABASE_URL="$API_URL" SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="${PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-$ANON_KEY}" exec pnpm dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3000}
